description: This file defines the ModelCatalogLoader enum which provides static functions to locate, load, sanitize, and parse a JavaScript-based model catalog. It includes methods for resolving file paths, caching catalog files, and extracting model metadata from a JavaScript object embedded in the source code.

methods.name: load(from:)
methods.description: Asynchronously loads and parses the model catalog from a specified path, evaluates JavaScript code, and returns an array of ModelChoice objects sorted by provider and name.

methods.name: resolveDefaultPath
methods.description: Determines the default path to the model catalog, prioritizing cached, bundled, or node_modules paths.

methods.name: resolvePath(preferred:)
methods.description: Resolves the actual file path to use, falling back to bundled or cached versions if the preferred path is not accessible.

methods.name: bundleCatalogPath
methods.description: Provides the path to the bundled 'models.generated.js' resource within the app bundle.

methods.name: nodeModulesCatalogPath
methods.description: Searches for the catalog in node_modules directories within project root and current working directory.

methods.name: cacheCatalog(sourcePath:)
methods.description: Caches the catalog file from sourcePath into the cache directory for faster future access.

methods.name: sanitize(source:)
methods.description: Cleans the JavaScript source string, extracting the models object definition and removing specific patterns for consistency.
